import cv2,numpy as np,importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ja','/app/jump_analyzer.py'); ja=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ja)
frames=ja.read_frames('/app/example_video.mp4')
def run(detect,thr):
 h,w=frames[0].shape
 sub=cv2.createBackgroundSubtractorMOG2(history=60,varThreshold=16,detectShadows=detect)
 for _ in range(3): sub.apply(frames[0],learningRate=1.0)
 ok=cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE,(3,3)); dk=cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE,(15,15))
 out=[]
 for fr in frames:
  m=sub.apply(fr); _,m=cv2.threshold(m,thr,255,cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
  m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,ok); m=cv2.dilate(m,dk,iterations=1)
  n,lab,st,ce=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m,8)
  if n<=1: out.append(None); continue
  idx=1+np.argmax(st[1:,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]); x,y,ww,hh,a=map(int,st[idx,[0,1,2,3,4]])
  out.append({'area':a,'x':x,'y':y,'w':ww,'h':hh,'bottom':y+hh,'cx':float(ce[idx][0])})
 return out,w,h
for detect,thr in [(False,127),(True,200),(True,250),(True,127)]:
 b,w,h=run(detect,thr)
 r=ja.find_run(b,w,h)
 print('detect',detect,'thr',thr,'run',r[0] if r else None,r[-1] if r else None,'est',ja.estimate_jump(frames))
 if r:
  print(' bottoms',[(i,b[i]['bottom']) for i in r])
